# 3300 Landing Page

*A personal landing page built as a course project for BAIS 3300 — Digital Product Management at the University of Iowa.*

## Description

This is a single-page personal landing page for Jordan Mercer, a Business Analytics student at the University of Iowa's Tippie College of Business. The page gives recruiters and hiring managers a polished destination to review Jordan's skills, professional experience, and project work within 60–90 seconds. It is built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and minimal JavaScript — no frameworks.

## Features

- Professional hero section with headshot, tagline, and call-to-action
- About section summarizing education, internship experience, and volunteer work
- Skills displayed as grouped pill badges across three categories (Technical, Professional, Tools)
- Detailed experience section with accomplishments and tools used
- Two-column project cards showcasing academic and personal projects
- Education section with GPA and Dean's List recognition
- Contact section with email, LinkedIn, and GitHub icon links
- Fully responsive layout from 320px mobile to desktop widths
- WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessible (semantic HTML, heading hierarchy, descriptive alt text and link labels)
- Sticky navigation bar with smooth-scrolling anchor links and mobile hamburger menu

## Tech Stack

| Technology | Purpose |
|---|---|
| HTML5 | Page structure and semantic markup |
| CSS3 | All styling, layout, and responsive design |
| JavaScript (vanilla) | Mobile navigation toggle |
| Google Fonts (Inter) | Typography |
| SVG icons (inline) | Contact section icons (email, LinkedIn, GitHub) |
| Azure Static Web Apps | Production hosting |
| GitHub | Version control and CI/CD deployment |
| Replit | AI-assisted development environment |

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- A modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge)
- [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads) installed on your machine
- Any local HTTP server for development (Python 3 recommended)

### Installation

1. Clone the repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/mikecolbert/3300-landing-page.git
   ```
2. Navigate into the project directory:
   ```bash
   cd 3300-landing-page
   ```
3. Start a local development server:
   ```bash
   python3 -m http.server 5000
   ```
4. Open your browser and go to `http://localhost:5000`

## Usage

Once the server is running, the landing page is fully viewable in your browser. Use the sticky navigation bar to jump between sections. On mobile screens, tap the hamburger icon to expand the navigation menu. All external links (LinkedIn, GitHub) open in a new tab.

To customize the page with your own content, edit `index.html` to update text, links, and the headshot image. Modify `css/stylesheet.css` to change colors, fonts, or layout. The color palette is defined as CSS custom properties at the top of the stylesheet for easy theming.
